data.source_title: Hospital Factors Impact Variation in Emergency Department Length of Stay More Than Physician Factors
data.locator: Methods, Study Setting and Population; Table 2; Table 3
data.source_setting: Urban county hospital, Corpus Christi, Texas, United States; Level II trauma center with 41,000 annual visits and 18% admission rate.
data.source_period: Daily interval averages collected over one year; exact calendar dates are not stated in the opened article text. Authors compare daily averages above/below the 2008 national median LOS threshold of 154 minutes.
data.source_n: Approximately 41,000 annual visits; number of daily observations not stated.
data.quantity: Door-to-room median by lower- versus higher-LOS day group
data.source_evidence_basis: Measured daily ED information-system interval averages; reported medians and SDs for two groups, not a patient-level distribution. Door-to-room is arrival to an available treatment room.
data.limitations: The 154-minute grouping threshold is the 2008 NHAMCS national median; these values are from one hospital and are not national arrival-to-room priors. Confounders such as radiology, laboratory, and acuity markers were not included. external_proxy_candidate; qualitative confidence: moderate for a site-specific operational comparator, low for transfer.

data.source_title: Hospital Factors Impact Variation in Emergency Department Length of Stay More Than Physician Factors
data.source_setting: Urban county hospital, Corpus Christi, Texas, United States; Level II trauma center, 41,000 annual visits; admission rate 18%.
data.source_period: Daily interval averages collected over one year; calendar dates not stated in the opened article text.
data.source_n: Approximately 41,000 annual visits; number of daily observations not stated.
data.quantity: Admit decision to ED departure median, an ED boarding interval
data.source_evidence_basis: Measured operational interval from admission decision until patient physically departs the ED treatment area; Table 2 reports medians and SDs by ED LOS group.
data.limitations: This is boarding after the admission decision, not inpatient bed turnaround from bed request, and group membership is based on whole-day discharged-patient LOS versus the national 154-minute threshold. It is not active clinical service time. external_proxy_candidate; qualitative confidence: moderate for observed site boarding, low for transfer.
